## Note on B7 at DC (2026-11-08)

7 of 45 runs give 30.4–36.6 dB at DC, all at VDPWR = 1.62 V with −40 °C or 125 °C (27 °C at 1.62 V: ≥ 40.7 dB).
Diagnosis (`.op` at the worst cases):
- fs / 125 °C: the OTA input pair is at the edge of triode (Vds 0.20 V, Vdsat 0.16 V).
- sf / −40 °C: the OTA tail M5 is in triode (Vds 0.05 V).
- At every hot corner, MPC (the VBG source) has only 0.42 V across it while MPA/MPB have 1.1 V. Their
  output conductances differ, so supply changes reach VBG.

Experiments on these cases (`.op` + AC only): an input pair at 32/4 changes nothing; 32/4 plus loads at 8/8 reaches
36.8 dB at fs / 125 °C but leaves the others at 33–37 dB. No cheap fix was found. Effect on the ADC: 30 dB is
32 mV/V, i.e. 10 mV of supply ripple at 1.62 V moves VREF by about 0.3 mV (0.07 LSB). B4 (line regulation 1.62–1.98 V)
passes in every corner. See the B7 note in `docs/specs/bandgap.md`.
